data.hypothesis: Reassociating mass times inverse-distance cubed as (mass * invDist) * (invDist * invDist) keeps one rsqrtf and the same multiplication count while creating two independent products before the final scale multiply. This may shorten the dependent arithmetic path; changed float32 rounding means correctness and scored-size timing still require controller measurement.
data.notes: The supplied source already uses rsqrtf and cancels target mass in acceleration. This candidate tests only multiplication reassociation, retains the self-interaction skip and dt integration, and makes no speedup claim. The prior h01 diagnostic reports a correctness failure at quadruple_size; the cause is not established. No commands or measurements were run here; rely on controller correctness and scored-size geometric-mean event-time evaluation.
transformations: Reassociate the acceleration scale from mass * ((invDist * invDist) * invDist) to (mass * invDist) * (invDist * invDist), allowing the mass/inverse-distance and inverse-distance-square products to proceed independently while retaining the existing single reciprocal-square-root and self-interaction guard.
